lead: A `Core` attribute name cannot be a `rule:attributes/attach-sites-and-forms` shape alias, because there is no `Core`-seeded alias table.
body: `nvs_hir::AliasTable` is collected from source `type` declarations only (`crates/nvs-hir/src/aliases.rs`), so `Core\Command` reaches `nvs_types::attributes::resolve_shape_alias` with no entry and the answer is `E0726: … is not a `type` alias` — a refusal no stdlib edit can lift. Every `Core`-owned attribute is a nominal match on `nvs_types::derive::ATTRIBUTES` and owes a pass that checks its payload, or `#[Command(nmae: "x")]` is admitted in silence.
